feature.title: Email-first Endowment Pilot — US and EU First

notes: Planning, the requested Linear reconciliation and draft-PR publication are authorized; no runtime implementation, dependency changes, provider contact, accounts, personal data, payments or broadcasts.
User selected an endowment: donor retains redeemable ownership; direct garden donation remains a distinct flow.
Stripe entitlement/use-case approval, an existing verified Arbitrum vault and bounded background execution are prerequisite gates; none is certified by this hub.

US and EU donors are the initial acquisition priority by user direction and expected capital origin; this demand assumption is not measured market evidence. US L0 and EU required L2 are separate cohorts.

Later conditional routes: Brazil Ramp Pix versus Fonbnk Pix; South Africa Fonbnk bank redirect; Nigeria Fonbnk remains no-go for the target checkout while manual confirmation and verification gaps persist. MoonPay is comparison-only.
All regions require email recovery, donor-owned shares, bounded automatic execution after payment and no second endowment confirmation. A passing route does not certify another country or method.

Existing Linear project Garden Fiat Contributions and PRD-1031 mirror this hub; existing delivery issues are retained without creating duplicate lane issues. Reconciled live fields use preserve_existing sync behavior.

The linked Linear specification and verified issue/dependency mapping are recorded in handoffs/linear-sync.md. All implementation/QA proofs remain pending; a plan-only branch and draft PR were subsequently requested.

tdd.note: Future email/card/review behavior needs focused proof; no UI implementation has begun.
